A bootstrap website with a few pages: Home, Contributors, data, publications, etc. Then make a template for each type in super simple html. A header and a few p tags. author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
@ONScience @protohedgehog We can just keep it super simple. A bootstrap website with a few pages: Home, Contributors, data, publications, etc.

Then make a template for each type in super simple html. A header and a few p tags.

Use the process of creating a contributor page and then submitting a resource as a stealth way to onboard #openscience folks onto GitHub.

Most will use web interface and not Command line
